# UpdateShelf

Fictional raw product brief for evaluating landing-page decisions.

Audience: a solo developer shipping a paid developer tool who already writes
Markdown release notes but needs a readable page to share with current users.

Supported behavior:
- Paste Markdown release notes into an editor.
- Preview the formatted update before publishing it.
- Publish one update page with its own shareable URL.
- Edit the published update later.

Intended CTA: `Preview an update`.
Existing website: plain HTML and CSS, light blue background, compact layout.

No GitHub integration, automated drafting, email sending, subscriber lists,
analytics, or custom domains. No AI feature. Pricing, hosting details, and
product availability are unknown. No customer testimonials, measured time
savings, or business outcomes. No actual service endpoint is supplied.

Current hero: UpdateShelf is a powerful end-to-end publishing platform that
empowers teams to revolutionize communication and unlock meaningful engagement.
